independent_null_replication.note: Post-freeze independent diagnostic; does not select a method or change any neural confirmatory inference.

limitations: Unknown relocated higher-order interactions can remain undetected
Rare events may be insufficiently sampled
Ideal clique theorem is not a bitwise hardware certificate
Fixed graph/training cohort, no population inference

numerical_exact_classifier_underflows.note: Raw exact-tail float underflows are preserved, but valid positive upper p-values are exported in classifier-safe-pvalues.csv using a proved finite-population Hoeffding bound. Every alpha=.05 decision is unchanged. Main n=250-per-class tails are representable; no zero Monte Carlo p-value is allowed.

teacher_reference_diagnostic.note: Read-only implementation diagnostic with simultaneous TV bounds; no method or neural decision is selected using this check.
